title: Human collision/stuck recovery -> automatic recovery manoeuvre parameters (JetFormer, 2026-10-10)

conventions.hall_counts: erpm/10 per second; 6 per electrical rev; increases when reversing

data.note: effective command = AI out while CH3 selects AI, transmitter pwm otherwise

esc_reverse_rule.threshold_sensitivity: R band threshold 20-60 us above neutral: identical conclusions (human after-F 0/29-0/31, rolling-forward 0/9-0/11, after-brake 33/37); at 80 us one human after-F case flips because a weak brake (<1578 us) is then counted as neutral
esc_reverse_rule.statement: Reverse drive engages only if (1) the last non-neutral command was R (a brake) of >= ~1560 us for >= ~0.1 s, (2) then neutral, (3) the motor is not turning forward (eRPM >= -150) when R is applied again. The first R after any forward command (even a 30 ms forward blip) only brakes, indefinitely. Reverse->forward has no lockout.
esc_reverse_rule.ai_natural_experiment: 173445 t=99.0-100.2: AI output R1665 (brake) -> N 0.20 s -> R1701 and the car reversed 112 counts (then hit something behind at t=100.17, 2.6 g)

episodes_classification.A: collision/stuck against wall/obstacle (n=19: 9 human-only, 10 AI-run takeovers)
episodes_classification.B: braked to stop near obstacle, no impact (n=4)
episodes_classification.C: manoeuvring/repositioning without obstacle (n=5, excluded from parameters)

detection.forward_stall_observed: forward command with |eRPM|<100 and no hall motion >=0.15 s: only 2 runs (0.18 s each, both normal starts) in 1030 s; the AI stuck signature is R commanded while stationary (ESC brake lockout) for 1.08-2.06 s until takeover
detection.D1: impact |a|-1g >= 2.5 g (>=2 samples >1 g within +-50 ms) while moving forward (median eRPM over previous 0.2 s < -500); eRPM > -300 within 0.6 s; forward progress < 20 hall counts during the next 0.5 s -> trigger
detection.D2: still (|eRPM|<150 and |dHall|<=2 per 0.1 s) while command outside the neutral band (thr<1478 or thr>1538) continuously for >= 0.6 s; masked for 1.0 s after AI start / hand-back

recommended_state_machine.units: absolute PWM us, bypass apply_gains (throttle_gain must not scale these)
recommended_state_machine.DETECT: D1 or D2 (see detection); latency = stop + 0.5 s (D1) / stop + >=0.6 s (D2)

BRAKE.why: first R after forward is always a brake; also kills forward roll

REVERSE.steer: centre 1443 (or <=150 us opposite to the pre-stop steering); never same side
REVERSE.engage_check: hall +5 within 0.30 s else NEUTRAL 0.2 s and retry (max 3 cycles)
REVERSE.release_when: hall >= +40 counts since engagement or eRPM >= 2200 or 0.5 s of R
REVERSE.expected_total: ~100-120 counts incl. coast (~0.6 s of motion)
REVERSE.abort: impact >= 2.5 g while reversing -> NEUTRAL, go to ESCAPE

ESCAPE_FORWARD.steer_us: full lock away from the contact side: impact a_y < -2 g (left contact) -> ~1000 (right); a_y > +2 g -> ~1890 (left); otherwise the pre-stop steering direction

HANDBACK.condition: eRPM < -1500 (moving forward) after ESCAPE, sticks neutral up to 0.4 s

recommended_state_machine.COOLDOWN: D2 masked 1.0 s after hand-back; D1 always armed (needs a new impact)
recommended_state_machine.ESCALATE: if re-stuck within 10 s after hand-back: reverse target x1.5 (~170 counts) and ESCAPE 0.8 s at full lock
recommended_state_machine.GIVE_UP: (a) no reverse engagement after 3 NEUTRAL->REVERSE cycles (~1.5 s); (b) 3 recoveries within 20 s; (c) re-stuck within 5 s after hand-back twice in a row -> hold neutral, request human (CH3)
